JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
